tool.name: Count label overlaps

param.name: label1_min
param.label: The minimum value of label1 to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).
param.help: The minimum value of label1 to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).

param.name: label1_max
param.label: The maximum value of label1 to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).
param.help: The maximum value of label1 to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).

param.name: average
param.label: Compute average number of label2 per label1 instead of number of label2 by label1
param.help: Compute average number of label2 per label1 instead of number of label2 by label1

param.name: input_dataframe
param.label: Input DataFrame (CSV)
param.help: Optional CSV file containing input DataFrame for batch processing

tool.help: Count the number (or average number) of overlapping labels. For example: 3 label2 on label1 number 1, 4 label2 on label1 number 2, etc. If average is true, the average number of label2 per label1 is returned.
